## Drift count summary

**6 total drifts** (3 pre-confirmed, 3 newly found in this pass) + 1 informational cross-reference
(undeclared runtime deps for documented features, detailed in `path_violations.md`'s sibling report
`structural_inventory.json`). Top 3 by materiality: (1) file-count staleness (#1) since it appears in
the most-visible Quick Info table and is off by 16-66 depending on which of the two numbers is read;
(2) test-file-count staleness (#5), which understates real test coverage breadth by 18 files/40%;
(3) the shim-path Key Components entries (#2, #3), which will send a reader straight to dead files
if they try to `Read` the path CLAUDE.md names.
